caveats.detected_by: Looks for `[aria-label*="breadcrumb"]`, `.breadcrumb`, or `.breadcrumbs` on the page.
caveats.blind_spot: A breadcrumb implemented with different markup or class names is invisible to this check.
caveats.disprove: Open the screen and look at the top of the content area for a route-hierarchy trail before adding a new component.

caveats.detected_by: Looks for `input[type="search"]`, `[role="searchbox"]`, `[aria-label*="search"]` inside the page's `header`/`nav`/`aside`/`[role="banner"]`, or a shell button/trigger whose accessible label matches search / Cmd+K / Ctrl+K patterns.
caveats.blind_spot: A search entry point with neither a search-related accessible name nor a standard search input role can still be missed.
caveats.disprove: Check this run's own UI inventory for a search input or a button labelled like "Search ..." / Cmd+K in the topbar before building a new palette.

caveats.detected_by: Scans the first 50KB of page HTML for the literal substrings `ctrl`, `cmd`, or the ⌘/⇧ glyphs.
caveats.blind_spot: Shortcuts documented inside a help modal that loads lazily, or that use words like "hotkey" instead of ctrl/cmd, are missed.
caveats.disprove: Open any help/settings panel on the screen and check for a shortcuts list before adding one.

caveats.detected_by: Scans the first 50KB of page HTML for the literal substrings `help`, `tooltip`, or `info`.
caveats.blind_spot: Icon-only tooltips implemented via `title` attributes, custom popovers, or lazy-loaded content past the 50KB scan window can be missed.
caveats.disprove: Hover the non-obvious icon controls on the screen before adding new tooltip markup.

caveats.detected_by: Looks for `[data-company-selector]` / `[data-branch-selector]` / `[data-fy-selector]`, native `<select name*="company|branch|financial">`, and shell button/combobox labels matching company/branch/FY/year patterns (or a bare tenant name beside a FY/branch sibling). Only fires on authenticated app shells with no selector kinds in that screen's inventory. Action-verb labels like "Add Company" are excluded.
caveats.blind_spot: A company switcher outside the shell header/nav, or a bare tenant name with no FY/branch sibling nearby and no company/branch/FY keyword, can still be missed.
caveats.disprove: Check this run's own UI inventory for topbar buttons showing a company name, "HO"/branch code, or a year range (e.g. "2026 - 27") before adding a new selector. Also confirm the screen is actually an authenticated, multi-company screen and not the pre-login landing page.

caveats.detected_by: Requires a visible table (`meta.tables > 0`) and no export evidence: the word "export" nowhere in page text, no "Download" paired with CSV/Excel/XLSX/XLS/PDF/sheet wording, no visible control whose label matches export/download-tabular patterns, and no inventory kind `export` or `download`.
caveats.blind_spot: An export action rendered as an icon-only button, inside an overflow/kebab menu, or using wording that mentions neither export nor a tabular download format (e.g. bare "Download list") can still be missed.
caveats.disprove: Check this run's inventory and the table toolbar for Export or Download CSV/Excel/PDF before adding a new Export control.

caveats.detected_by: Requires a visible table and neither the literal word "print" nor "download" anywhere in the page's visible text.
caveats.blind_spot: Print/Download actions behind an overflow menu or expressed with icon-only buttons are missed.
caveats.disprove: Check the table's row and header action menus before adding new Print/Download controls.

caveats.detected_by: Requires a visible table and zero filter evidence: `select` / `[role="combobox"]` / `.filter` / `[class*="filter"]`, `[aria-haspopup="listbox"]`, `input[type="date|datetime-local"]`, `input[type="search"]` / `[role="searchbox"]`, search-trigger buttons, All/status/from/to/department/branch/category/type chips in the same section as a table, or inventory kinds `search`/`filter`.
caveats.blind_spot: Icon-only filter controls with neither a listbox popup, date input, nor a recognised toolbar label can still be missed.
caveats.disprove: Look for date-range, status, SearchableSelect-style listbox, or search controls above the table before adding a new filter bar.

caveats.detected_by: Counts visible buttons sharing an identical accessible label/text; flags any custom label repeated more than twice. Intentionally identical placeholder labels ("— select —", "Select", "Choose") and standard CRUD row actions (Edit / Deactivate / Delete / View / All / Approve / Reject) are not emitted — they are design-system patterns, not product defects.
caveats.blind_spot: A product that reuses a non-standard label across unrelated actions (e.g. thrice-repeated "Save draft") is still flagged; confirm those controls are truly ambiguous before renaming.
caveats.disprove: If the finding names a placeholder or standard row-action string, treat it as a detector artifact (no visible-copy change). For custom duplicated labels, disambiguate with icon + label or context-specific copy.

caveats.detected_by: Compares the widest visible table/modal's bounding-box width or height against the viewport at capture time, but only when no ancestor has computed `overflow-x`/`overflow-y` of `auto` or `scroll` with a constrained client size.
caveats.blind_spot: A scroll wrapper that uses a non-standard overflow value, or that becomes scrollable only after a later layout pass, can still be missed.
caveats.disprove: Resize the browser and check whether the table/modal already scrolls inside an overflow-auto/scroll container before adding a new scroll wrapper.

caveats.detected_by: Flags the page when a real script exception (`pageerror`) or non-resource console `error` was captured. Resource-load 404 console messages (logo/image/font) alone do not emit a UX issue.
caveats.blind_spot: A non-404 console error that is still benign (third-party noise) can be flagged; conversely, a script exception swallowed before reaching the console is missed.
caveats.disprove: Read the actual console message. Confirm it is a script exception or hard failure before treating it as a P1 bug hunt. Soft asset 404s are intentionally silent.

caveats.detected_by: Counts hard failed (`ok: false`) network requests that are not analytics noise and not soft assets (logo/image/font). Soft-asset-only failures do not emit a UX issue; expected create conflicts (HTTP 409) emit as low severity.
caveats.blind_spot: Ownership is resolved from the *page* URL, not the *failing request* URL. If the product's API lives on a different host/path prefix than its frontend, the finding lands on the frontend repository even when the failing endpoint belongs to the backend repository.
caveats.disprove: Check the failing request's own URL against the repository ownership rules before assuming this repository owns the fix. Soft asset 404s are intentionally silent; a 5xx on a data endpoint is a backend defect.

caveats.detected_by: Looks for legacy markup: `table[border]`, `font`/`marquee`/`blink` tags, `[bgcolor]`, `img[align]`, or `<center>`.
caveats.blind_spot: A modern component that happens to render one of these attributes for a legitimate reason (rare) would be a false positive; conversely, legacy styling done purely in CSS without these tags is missed.
caveats.disprove: Confirm the flagged markup is actually legacy-authored, not a modern component's incidental output, before migrating anything.

caveats.detected_by: Regex-matches page text for phrases like "no records", "no ... selected", "nothing here", or "select a ... to ...", only on authenticated screens with zero visible tables.
caveats.blind_spot: Any short sentence coincidentally matching the pattern (not actually a fallback state) would be misclassified; a genuine fallback state whose wording falls outside the pattern is missed.
caveats.disprove: Confirm the screen is genuinely blocked waiting for a prerequisite (company/branch/FY selection, no data yet) rather than a normal empty list.

caveats.detected_by: Manual/heuristic probe of `<input type="date">` fields; flags any native date input, since its displayed order follows the browser's locale rather than the product's.
caveats.blind_spot: None significant — this is a real product-level inconsistency risk on any native date input, independent of which locale a given tester's browser was pinned to.
caveats.disprove: Verify the exact field names/labels named in the finding still use native date inputs before building a custom date control.

caveats.detected_by: Compares an uploaded/exported fixture file's content and structure after a round trip through the product.
caveats.blind_spot: A fidelity mismatch can originate in the upload path, the export/render path, or the storage layer; the finding does not localize which one.
caveats.disprove: Reproduce the round trip locally and bisect which stage (upload, storage, export) introduces the mismatch before changing code.

caveats.detected_by: Splits the expected capability's display name into whitespace tokens and requires every token to appear (as a whole word, or substring for longer tokens) somewhere in the observed inventory's labels/URLs/hrefs, page titles/module names, or a product-agnostic synonym map (e.g. directory↔employees/staff/people). When synonyms cover every token, the capability is treated as observed and no gap row is emitted. Partial matches that only hit a generic session-family anchor (attendance/leave/payroll/employee) while distinctive tokens are missing become `validate_first` instead of `implement`.
caveats.blind_spot: A capability that exists under a name outside both the literal tokens and the synonym map can still be reported as `partial`/`implement` when a distinctive token did match. `matched_context` in the evidence lists exactly which tokens were found.
caveats.disprove: Compare `matched_context` in the evidence against the full expected-feature name. If the missing tokens look like near-synonyms of UI that already exists, search this repository for the capability by its actual route/component name before implementing anything.

caveats.detected_by: Emitted when (a) the capability is outside session scope with only weak/no evidence, (b) session-family expansion pulled it into scope but inventory matched zero tokens (e.g. Attendance session → shift scheduler / timesheet with no UI hits), or (c) a partial match only found a generic family anchor while distinctive tokens were missing (e.g. geo attendance matching only attendance).
caveats.blind_spot: Zero evidence is not evidence of absence — the capability may live in a module this run never visited, or under a name outside the synonym map.
caveats.disprove: This is a scope question, not a defect. Confirm with the product owner before opening any implementation ticket; do not treat this as a build order.

fallback.detected_by: A generic heuristic check specific to this finding's category.
fallback.blind_spot: Heuristic DOM/text checks cannot see every valid implementation of a capability.
fallback.disprove: Verify directly against the live screen and this repository's code before implementing anything.
